modes.always: Always optimize unless bypassed with --raw, raw:, or [RAW] tags
modes.opt-in: Only optimize when prompt starts with ++, +opt, or opt:
modes.opt-out: Optimize by default, skip with --skip, --noopt, or skip:
modes.disabled: Never optimize (hook still runs but passes through)

description: Configure prompt optimizer behavior. Change 'mode' to one of: always, opt-in, opt-out, disabled
